concerns.text: User Story US‑2 (T010) depends on embeddings generated in US‑1 (T009). This makes US‑2 not independently shippable as required; a story must be testable end‑to‑end without relying on artifacts from another story.

User Story US‑3 (T011, T012) depends on fidelity metrics from US‑2 (T010) and geometric descriptors from US‑1 (T008). Consequently US‑3 cannot be executed as an independent, self‑contained unit, violating the independently‑shippable story requirement.
